name: Edamame "Waldorf" Salad with Apple, Grapes & Celery
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Zest and juice lemon into a medium bowl, then add mayo, water, sugar, and spices. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Trim and small dice celery. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Halve grapes. Add to the bowl.
Quarter, core, and small dice apples. Add to the bowl.
Place edamame in a colander and rinse under hot, running water (from the tap) to defrost. Add to the bowl and stir to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls and enjoy!
author: Mealime
